messages:
People Ops: Quick idea for the upcoming review cycle — a tiny, copy-pasteable self-review template that stays under ~250 words. Focus = 2-sentence impact anchor + 1-line context + 2 evidence bullets + 1-line ask. Example below, please react with :thumbsup: if useful or add tweaks.

alex: Love the brevity. Can we add a short 'scope' note so reviewers know the bounds? e.g., 'scope: infra -> batching rules'

maria: Agree with @alex. Also suggest adding an optional 'metrics link' line so people can drop a dashboard URL. Keeps claims verifiable.

jamal: +1. Also would be great to include a manager prompt set (3 lines) so managers know how to give focused feedback.

People Ops: Good call — here's a compact template + manager prompts (pasteable):
```
Self-review template (<=250 words)
Impact anchor: Led X, delivering Y for Z. (1-2 short sentences)
Scope / constraints: What you owned and any limits (1 line)
Evidence: - Metric or artifact 1 (link) - Concrete result or customer quote 2
Ask: What you want from manager / team next (1 line)
```

Example filled: 
"Impact anchor: Led rollout of Optimize batching rules, reducing per-token cost by ~18% for enterprise inference workloads while maintaining p95 latency SLOs.
Scope / constraints: Focused on high-throughput model routes; non-blocking for low-volume customers.
Evidence: - Deploy 2026-02-10, graphs: dashboard.company.com/r/123 - Customer A: 'saw immediate cost drop on our monthly bill'
Ask: Align on next-quarter owner for broader routing rollout and a path to owning a customer-facing postmortem."

sophia: This is great. Can we add one micro-phrase cheat for managers to keep feedback concrete?

kelly: Two quick manager prompts: 1) "What part of this should we amplify?" 2) "What would make this work more impactful next quarter?" 3) "Which skill should we prioritize for development?"

alex: Might also be helpful to include an optional 'challenge' bullet: one thing that slowed you and what you learned. Keeps reviews growth-focused.

People Ops: Updated final stanza to include 'challenge' as optional. I'm going to put this in the self-review template doc and the cycle kickoff email. If anyone wants a different wording for IC vs manager-senior roles, drop suggestions here — otherwise I'll ship. :sparkles:
